name: Tony
source: Daniel’s self-proclaimed number one fan and best friend. Daniel would describe Tony as a “happy, optimistic idiot” as well as one of the kindest people he has ever met. He owns a bar but never drinks, and he’s a lot more mature than Daniel would like to admit to his face.
